title: Does the Powerball Winner Really Get $847 Million? 💸 #Shorts
description:
Does the Powerball winner really get $847 million? Nope. The $847 million jackpot won in New Jersey is the annuity: 30 payments over 29 years, each about 5% bigger than the last. Take the cash option today and it's $363.1 million, the money actually in the prize pot right now. Invested for 29 years, that pot grows into the $847 million ad number. Then the IRS withholds 24% off the top, and more is due at tax time (the top federal rate is 37%). The odds of hitting the jackpot: 1 in 292,201,338.

Explained in 60, podcast edition. Where Your Money Goes.
